policies.excerpt:
Step 1 | Designate the Principal Officer for customer identification and record-keeping. (Compliance | 1.1)
Step 2 | Complete Customer Due Diligence for every new relationship before activation. (Operations | 1.2)
Step 3 | Periodic KYC updation: high-risk every 2 years, medium every 8, low every 10. (Operations | 1.3)
Step 4 | Refresh KYC for high-risk accounts within 30 days of risk-category change. (Compliance | 2.1)
Evidence: KYC registry extract, exception report CSV, STR/CTR filing log, screening log, board minutes, audit pack.
policies.title: Internal KYC Policy

policies.excerpt:
Step 1 | Appoint the CISO for cyber posture and incident-response readiness. (IT | 1.1)
Step 2 | Maintain board-approved Information Security policy; review every 12 months. (IT | 1.2)
Step 3 | Report every cyber incident to the Reserve Bank within 6 hours of detection. (IT | 2.1)
Step 4 | Enforce MFA for all privileged and remote admin access. (IT | 2.2)
Evidence: incident tickets + RBI reporting log, MFA report, audit-log sample, VA/PT reports.
policies.title: Cyber Incident Policy

policies.excerpt:
Step 1 | Identify critical operations and map supporting people/processes/tech/third parties. (Operations | 1.1)
Step 2 | Set impact tolerances per critical operation; Board approves yearly. (Risk | 1.2)
Step 3 | RTO <= 4h and RPO <= 2h per critical operation; test recovery every 6 months. (Operations | 2.1)
Step 4 | Alternate processing sites able to assume critical operations within RTO. (Operations | 2.2)
Evidence: critical-operations register, tolerance approvals, RTO/RPO test reports, drill log.
policies.title: Operational Resilience Policy

policies.excerpt:
Designate the MLRO, run annual enterprise-wide risk assessment, diligence correspondent banking, capture wire-transfer particulars, monitor PEPs, deploy trade-based laundering rules, screen virtual-asset exposures, report attempted suspicious transactions, and retain records for 5 years.
Evidence: Risk assessment report, wire transfer audit logs, PEP screening register, STR filings.
policies.title: AML/CFT Policy

policies.excerpt:
Maintain central outsourcing register, risk-assess material arrangements for Board approval, diligence providers, contract audit rights and data ownership, manage concentration and exit strategies, enforce data localisation in India, control subcontracting, and audit material arrangements annually.
Evidence: Central outsourcing register, board approvals, vendor audit reports, exit strategy plans.
policies.title: IT Outsourcing Policy

policies.excerpt:
Appoint Data Protection Officer, keep data inventory, enforce consent and purpose limitation, honour access/correction/erasure requests in 30 days, encrypt and tokenise data, notify breaches in 24/72 hours, schedule retention and anonymisation, govern third-party sharing, and assess new products before launch.
Evidence: DPO appointment record, data inventory, breach notification register, encryption certificates.
policies.title: Customer Data Privacy Policy

policies.excerpt:
Step 1 | Register nodal office on CIMS Sankalan portal with entity credentials. (Treasury | 1)
Step 2 | Download NRD-CSR return template v11.0.3 from RBI CIMS portal. (Treasury | 2)
Step 3 | Prepare monthly NRD-CSR data in prescribed .xlsx format. (Treasury | 3)
Step 4 | Submit monthly return via screen-based upload on CIMS portal. (Treasury | 4)
Step 5 | Maintain revised maturity codes and record types per Annex. (Treasury | Annex)
Step 6 | Run validation checks before submission; rectify errors. (Treasury | Annex)
Evidence: CIMS portal submission receipts, NRD-CSR template v11.0.3, validation check logs, nodal office registration confirmation.
policies.title: NRD-CSR Compliance Policy

policies.excerpt:
Step 1 | Calculate FERR as per RBI prescribed methodology. (Risk | 2)
Step 2 | Maintain FERR for all foreign exchange derivative contracts post-circular. (Risk | 5)
Step 3 | Report FERR details daily via RBI CIMS portal. (Risk | 4)
Step 4 | Monitor for circumvention: multiple transactions across dealers. (Risk | 3)
Step 5 | Flag violations for Board reporting. (Risk | 3)
Step 6 | Ensure FERR applies only to contracts after circular issuance. (Risk | 5)
Evidence: Daily CIMS FERR reports, FERR calculation workbooks, circumvention monitoring logs, Board violation reports.
policies.title: Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve Policy

policies.excerpt:
Step 1 | Enforce USD 100M single limit across all INR currency pairs. (Treasury | 2)
Step 2 | Apply USD 5M threshold for additional documentation facilities. (Treasury | 2(d))
Step 3 | Obtain undertaking: underlying exposure not hedged with another AD. (Treasury | 2(d))
Step 4 | Allow cancellation/rebooking only per RBI permitted scenarios. (Treasury | 2(a)-(c))
Step 5 | Track outstanding notional vs. limits daily. (Risk | 2)
Step 6 | Report limit breaches to Board within 24 hours. (Risk | 2)
Evidence: Position limit monitoring reports, customer undertakings, cancellation/rebooking logs, Board breach notifications.
policies.title: FX Derivatives Risk Management Policy
